title: Univer: Build Your Own AI-Powered Office

facts.method: Pinned official Univer README: Web SDK open-source core, sheets, docs, Facade APIs, and separate commercial extensions.
facts.limits: The developer supplies the model and agent orchestration; server collaboration and commercial AI extensions are separately licensed.

scenes.say: Build your own AI powered office. Meet Univer, an SDK for adding spreadsheets and documents right inside your app.
scenes.heading: BUILD YOUR OWN AI OFFICE

scenes.say: Start with editable sheets, formulas, sorting, and rich text documents.
scenes.heading: SHEETS + DOCS, BUILT IN

scenes.say: Plug in only the components you need, then connect your own AI agent through the same APIs your app uses.
scenes.heading: PLUG IN. CONNECT. BUILD.

scenes.say: Your agent can work with spreadsheet content while people edit it in your interface.
scenes.heading: PEOPLE + AGENTS

scenes.say: The open source core covers sheets and docs. Advanced collaboration and some AI extensions are separately licensed. You bring the model and orchestration.
scenes.heading: KNOW THE BOUNDARIES

scenes.say: Want the repo? Comment UNIVER and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
scenes.heading: YOUR CALL

viewer.problem: Building office editors and spreadsheet logic from scratch is complex
viewer.job: Understand how Univer embeds office components and connects existing agents

idea: Build an AI office inside your app with Univer SDK.

claims.text: Univer provides open-source Sheets and Docs editing in an SDK.
Applications and agents can use APIs to work with content; the app supplies its model and orchestration.
Advanced collaboration and some AI extensions are separately licensed.

proof_plan.how_shown: Custom illustrated editable sheets and docs with official README banner.
An agent and user connect through labeled API to a shared sheet; conceptual illustration, not a live demo.
Separate visual bands describe open-source core, licensed extensions, and developer-supplied model.
